title: Petrobras Hits Record High
subtitle: Petrobras reaches a record market value after a discovery in Amapá
excerpt: Petrobras reaches $700.08 billion in market value
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Petrobras reached $700.08 billion at the close of trading on B3, the São Paulo Stock Exchange, on Friday, beating its record market value, as reported by the company itself.

The discovery in Amapá was a key factor in this increase in Petrobras' market value.

This record market value is an indicator of the company's financial health and may influence investor confidence in the market.

With information from Agência Brasil.
